purpose: Close native movement/contact and moving-block helper consumers; not a new creature implementation or production repair.
native_contact: Entity.move clips requested motion against collision shapes; verticalCollisionBelow requires downward movement clipped. Ground support checks a thin AABB below feet. Horizontal collision zeros affected velocity; vertical contact invokes block fall behavior. noPhysics bypasses this.

collideBoundingBox combines block, eligible entity and border shapes. Axis clipping uses Y first, then X/Z ordered by requested magnitudes. VoxelShape.collideX clips against occupied voxel ranges with epsilon. This is AABB/voxel contact, not rotated armor-mesh collision or packing.

Entity.canBeCollidedWith defaults false. EntityGetter collects other shapes only through eligible collision predicates. Native FallingBlockEntity has no override in previously whole-read source, so pairs do not gain a pile solver merely by calling move. Other collidable entities may still be included.

Native FallingBlockEntity previously read attempts world-block placement after landing; that persistence changes the world and loses original continuous mesh transform. It cannot be called cosmetic scattered armor.
moving_block_helpers: AbstractMovingBlockEntity moves SELF and damps .98; no base gravity. Optional placement branch can destroy replaceable blocks, place actual world states, load block entity data, then remove. Exclude this branch from cosmetic design.

Its aggregate VoxelShape determines enclosing AABB; detail shape is not evidence of per-part oriented rigid-body collision. canBeCollidedWith false. createBlockDropAt uses block loot and popResource; not a static armor mesh pile.

CrushedBlock: actual grounded flag advances compression by .334; renderer scales Y and translates, then progress>=1 produces loot and discards. Compression is visual, not resized collision. canBePlaced/movesEntities false. Private progress used despite a separately defined synced progress field.

FallingTree: progress advances .05 without waiting for actual ground contact. Renderer rotates whole structure by progress squared times90. Completion offsets rotate to item-drop locations; no persistent fallen tree mesh. Save explicitly writes progress0, so reload does not preserve partial rotation.
MovingBlockData serializes blockstate, voxel-AABBs, integer offsets, optional NBT. Not a full bone/world transform handoff. Neither helper producer has been traced here to a creature death contract.
opacity_followup: Prior getRedGhost205-238 reused. Newly read EYES_ALPHA_TRANSPARENCY56-64 uses blendFuncSeparate(SRC_ALPHA,ONE,ONE,ONE_MINUS_SRC_ALPHA): additive RGB weighted by alpha. This closes blend-state definition, not custom shader output; shader source still unavailable.
No PNG or rendered image inspected in this batch. Alpha argument and blend configuration do not prove final pixels or depth behavior in game.
